name: manual_d6c81d
claim: Treat graph, prompt, node or strategy changes from an AutoResearcher or optimizer as untrusted candidates: automated graph evolution stays research-only until a versioned GraphSpec, GraphTrace corpus, locked evaluator, quality cost latency reliability metrics, candidate isolation and a promotion gate exist; the evaluator, safety policy and acceptance tests are fixed inputs the mutator cannot edit during the experiment; evaluate immutable candidates in contained runs on held-out data; promotion is an explicit operator-owned versioned decision with a rollback target, and a natural-language suggestion never mutates a production topology.

decisions.notes: Derived from the M1 generation-2 pin promotion of 2026-10-18 and the graph-optimization gating in orama-system doc 57 section 14, the R4 plan task T8c and the operator remaining-implementation notes. Convention: .agent/references/graduation-ceremony-mutation-approvals.md.
